decision: Preserve complete unchanged-inherited completion positives through a separate bounded route candidate producer; retain strict generic assessor.

source_findings.finding: assess_repository globally scans every tree/index path, requires regular blob modes, no untracked/ignored candidates, identical index/anchor/worktree bytes except owned JSON records. Therefore it cannot produce proof for valid unrelated inherited dirty or symlink cases.

Existing identity wire shape and verifier validate selected material-input membership, anchor/revision/current bytes, records and environment. They do not require every unrelated repository path to be a selected dependency; whole-tree producer restrictions need not be weakened.

Accepted F1/F2 version2 immutable bases separately bind all inherited index/worktree endpoints and compare all change layers. This provides the required unrelated-dirt preservation proof independently of selected dependency identity.

required_boundary: Keep generic assess_repository behavior and its negative tests intact; introduce route-only same-wire producer that requires version2 pinned authorization/inventory and explicit source anchor.

Use F1/F2 exact scope/preservation check for unrelated endpoints; require all selected material inputs regular, present and identical in anchor/index/live worktree with exact verifier/schema/authorization membership. Never exempt selected dependency via inherited dirt.
Recheck selected index/anchor/worktree identities and route scope on every direct/receipt proof consumption, not producer only; protected authorization/base records cannot use ownership masks.
Accept full done with real capture for unchanged unrelated tracked, untracked and symlink inherited endpoints; reject later mutation or selected inherited dependency.

Resolve actual active source or installed module layout from loaded files; require same-layout verifiers and consumed schemas in manifest. Do not accept duplicate bytes at unconsumed paths or mixed imports.
scope: Existing nine contracted product files; no installed edits or blanket acceptance downgrade.
